title: OL-20261126-1: ORCHESTRATE-1 ceiling: the orchestrator runs on the free Workers AI models and cannot run a test suite before its PR
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** orch_runs rows with phase 'failed' exceed rows with phase 'done' over 14 days
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/orchestrate.js::sandbox
**Status:** open

Structure is not capability. Two gaps remain between this and a frontier code-agent session: (1) the paid-model rung in seed/worker/src/airouter.js is capped at 0 by default, so planner, authors and reviewer are the free adapters in codeagent.js; (2) no step executes code, so verification before the PR is a model's reading and the repository's checks stay the gate. Next: a sandbox verify phase (Cloudflare Containers or Sandbox) and a budgeted paid rung for the plan and verify calls.
